title: Hymn and Portrait
author: Casper Almeida
blurb: Lena Dravenmoor, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
